stories.headline: Navi Pillay wins this year's Nobel Peace Prize
stories.summary: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize goes to Navi Pillay, a South African judge and former United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights. The Norwegian Nobel Committee announced the award in Oslo on 9 October, citing her efforts to promote peace and international law. The prize will be awarded on 10 December 2026.

stories.headline: A record fifth Most Valuable Player award for A'ja Wilson
stories.summary: A'ja Wilson of the Las Vegas Aces has won the WNBA Most Valuable Player award for a record fifth time. She is the first player in league history to win it three years in a row.

stories.headline: Cardinal Tagle is the first Asian to lead the College of Cardinals
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has approved the election of the Filipino cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle as dean of the College of Cardinals. Tagle is the first Asian to lead the body that elects a new pope. He has held the post since 9 October 2026.

stories.headline: South Africa yields the oldest known adult Homo erectus
stories.summary: Researchers have described the first known adult Homo erectus fossil from Drimolen Main Quarry, in South Africa's Cradle of Humankind. The specimen is about 2 million years old. That makes it roughly 200,000 years older than adult fossils of the species found elsewhere, including specimens from Dmanisi in Georgia.
